content.description: Comprehensive electrical wiring diagram showing the first gear circuit for a 4-cylinder engine. The diagram displays various electrical connections with red, yellow, and black wires connecting multiple components. The layout shows connections from a connector panel on the left side to various relays, switches, and control units throughout the vehicle system. The diagram uses color coding: red lines represent power circuits, yellow lines represent signal/control circuits, and black lines represent ground circuits.
